metadata.title: Anthropic is getting a $26 billion boost from Nvidia, Google and other tech giants - MarketWatch

content.text:
2 hours ago
Anthropic is getting a $26 billion boost from Nvidia, Google and other tech giants
Anthropic won't just be raising money from retail and institutional investors on Thursday, but also from its peers in the technology landscape.
"Immediately subsequent" to its IPO, a group of technology firms will buy $26 billion of Anthropic's Class N stock in a private placement, the company said in its prospectus.
Nvidia and Alphabet will each buy $10 billion of the stock, while Advanced Micro Devices has agreed to purchase $2.5 billion in stock. Broadcom, Micron Technology and Microsoft will each put in a billion-dollar order. And TSMC plans to buy $500 million worth of Anthropic stock.
